text: An idea. A first impression. A moment to connect.
But life doesn't pause when you unmute.
Meet Hearly. AI between your microphone and your meeting.
Train your voice, right on your Mac.
Hearly learns what makes you sound like you.
Then choose Hearly Microphone in your meeting's audio settings.
As you speak, Hearly separates your voice from typing, café noise, and conversations nearby.
Your voice moves forward. The distractions stay behind.
So you can share the idea. Finish the thought. Be there.
